name: @restregular/dsh-notepad
description: Notepad — a per-workspace floating notepad in the DeepSeek Harness session view with a dedicated settings tab (themes that also color the settings page, flat / frosted-glass surfaces, fonts, save mode, AI prompt presets with a read-only preset preview, button groups, hover delay, card height and captured geometry defaults), plugin undo / redo (placed next to copy-all in the header) that never overrides textarea history and covers typed text plus composer inserts / replaces with no drops, while sends stay irreversible and are never undone or replayed, collapsible segments with batch select / archive / delete / copy, an AI improve that switches to the selected text, re-selects it after rewriting and re-measures the textarea height, newest-first archives with auto-scroll and foldable archive cards, chat-composer sends mirrored into the workspace archive with content de-duplication (auto-saved messages start folded; manual archives and notepad sends start expanded), a right-aligned non-wrapping action bar whose overflow slides under the left selection label, a workspace dropdown limited to workspaces with an unarchived non-empty segment, oldest-first segment cards with click-to-edit titles, Enter split, Backspace merge (including the same exit animation for empty-card deletion), drag reorder, arrow-key navigation, delayed hover action groups that collapse after mouse activation and use distinct new-session insert / send icons, in-panel image previews, rotating shortcut tips, busy-send policy, image cleanup, pending badges, scroll-safe auto refresh and dark-mode styling. · 记事本 — 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话界面显示一个按工作区共享的分段便签浮窗，并新增「记事本」设置页：配色主题（同步作用于设置页）、纯色扁平 / 可调模糊的毛玻璃、字体字号、自动 / 手动保存、撤销步数、按钮组与 hover 阈值、AI 提示词预设（只读展示预设内容）、分段最大高度、可把当前面板位置尺寸存为默认。插件提供撤销 / 重做（按钮位于标题栏「复制全部」左侧，输入框仍用原生撤销，输入文字与插入 / 替换输入框也会进入插件历史而不会丢失；发送不进入撤销 / 重做，已发送分段不会被撤回或重发），分段可折叠，支持批量选择、归档、删除与复制；选中文字时 AI 只优化选中部分并在完成后重新选中，程序化改写后会重新测量文本区高度；归档按最新在上并自动滚动，Backspace 删除最后一条活动分段也不会清空归档；顶部工作区下拉只列出存在未归档且非空分段的工作区，点击切换到该工作区的新会话；工具栏为右对齐、不换行的单行按钮区，溢出时隐藏到左侧文本下方，批量操作时「取消选择」位于最左侧；Backspace 删除空分段也有退出动画；批量删除悬停变红；插入 / 发送的新会话图标相互区分；图片不显示名称，删除按钮位于缩略图右上角；分段进出都有过渡动画，自动保存不再把列表滚回顶部；AI 优化提高短内容输出预算并在空正文时自动重试；在对话框成功发送消息后自动存成当前工作区的归档分段并按内容去重，自动保存的分段默认折叠，手动归档和发送按钮归档的分段默认展开。
author: RestRegular
